title: Data types: Apache Parquet, JSON, CSV, Apache ORC, Apache Avro, RecordIO

cues.en: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're talking about types of data.
cues.zh: 今天討論資料類型。

cues.en: Now on the exam, when it comes to types of data, you just need to think about two things.
cues.zh: 考試遇到資料類型，只需考慮兩件事。

cues.en: First one is structured versus unstructured.
cues.zh: 第一，結構化與非結構化。

cues.en: Structured data, a classic example of structured data is a table.
cues.zh: 結構化資料的典型例子是表格。

cues.en: So here we see one in front of us.
cues.zh: 眼前就有一個。

cues.en: It can be an Excel table or inside a database such as an SQL database.
cues.zh: 可以是 Excel 表格，也可以存於 SQL 等資料庫。

cues.en: That is structured data.
cues.zh: 這就是結構化資料。

cues.en: But not all structured data has to be a table.
cues.zh: 但並非所有結構化資料都是表格。

cues.en: For example, a JSON document, which we see here, is nothing like a table, but nonetheless, inside it has a very clear structure.
cues.zh: 例如這裡的 JSON 文件，完全不像表格，但內部仍有非常清楚的結構。

cues.en: So that is also considered structured data.
cues.zh: 所以講者也將它歸為結構化資料。

cues.en: Now, in terms of unstructured data, you have things like social media, comments, posts, likes, so you have images, you have videos, audios, all sorts,
cues.zh: 非結構化資料，例如社群媒體留言、貼文、按讚，以及影像、影片、音訊等，

cues.en: any kind of text, including even in PDF documents.
cues.zh: 還有各種文字，甚至 PDF 文件裡的內容。

cues.en: Even though that's a specific file format, doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 即使有特定檔案格式，也不影響這個分類。

cues.en: Inside, it's texts.
cues.zh: 裡面是文字。

cues.en: Some tables maybe here and there, but mostly texts and images and things like that.
cues.zh: 可能這裡那裡有表格，但主要是文字、影像之類。

cues.en: So it is considered unstructured.
cues.zh: 所以視為非結構化。

cues.en: Now, the second thing you need to think about on the exam for types of data is labeled versus unlabeled.
cues.zh: 考試對資料類型要考慮的第二件事，是有標籤與無標籤。

cues.en: The first thing that comes to mind when we talk about labeled data is images of dogs and cats with the label cat or dog under it.
cues.zh: 談到有標籤資料，首先想到貓狗影像，下方寫著貓或狗。

cues.en: Indeed, that's labeled data, but we're gonna look at a slightly different example.
cues.zh: 確實是有標籤資料，但看看稍微不同的例子。

cues.en: Here we've got images of dogs and cats, and instead of the label of their, whether it's a dog or a cat, we have the label of how many pounds this animal weighs.
cues.zh: 這裡有貓狗影像，標籤不再表示貓或狗，而是動物重量多少磅。

cues.en: And I wanted to make a point here that a label is not just like an under, like, under an image explaining what the image is showing.
cues.zh: 想強調，標籤不只是影像下方解釋內容的文字。

cues.en: A label is anything that we are interested in predicting.
cues.zh: 標籤可以是任何想預測的東西。

cues.en: That's like our target variable.
cues.zh: 就像目標變數。

cues.en: Think about it that way.
cues.zh: 可以這樣理解。

cues.en: Like, "the answer that we want to predict," quote, unquote.
cues.zh: 就是所謂「想預測的答案」。

cues.en: The, quote, unquote, "answer that we wanna predict in our machine learning," is the label.
cues.zh: 機器學習裡「想預測的答案」，就是標籤。

cues.en: So in this case it would be the weight of the animal.
cues.zh: 這裡就是動物重量。

cues.en: In this case, we have a table, which has customers that visited our website, and it has the country they were from, the minutes they spent on the website,
cues.zh: 這裡有表格，包含造訪網站的顧客、來自國家、停留分鐘數，

cues.en: and how much money they spent, or how much products they purchased in dollars.
cues.zh: 以及花多少錢，或購買產品的金額。

cues.en: So in this case, we are interested in predicting that dollar amount, the purchasing, how much they purchased.
cues.zh: 這裡想預測金額，也就是買多少錢。

cues.en: So that would be the label.
cues.zh: 所以它就是標籤。

cues.en: So this is considered a labeled dataset.
cues.zh: 因此是有標籤資料集。

cues.en: Even though it's nothing to do with images, it's a table, each row is labeled because it has, quote, unquote, "the answer that we are interested in predicting."
cues.zh: 即使和影像無關，而是表格，每列仍有標籤，因為包含「想預測的答案」。

cues.en: So for future customers, we'll want to know if they're from the United States and they spend seven minutes on our website, how much money will they likely spend?
cues.zh: 未來顧客如果來自美國，在網站停留七分鐘，可能花多少錢？

cues.en: And we'll be able to do that because in this dataset, we have the label.
cues.zh: 因為資料集有標籤，就能學習這件事。

cues.en: So the other type of data in this sense is unlabeled data.
cues.zh: 這個角度下，另一種是無標籤資料。

cues.en: So for example, here we've got these same images, but with no label attached to them.
cues.zh: 例如相同影像，但沒有任何標籤。

cues.en: That is considered an unlabeled data.
cues.zh: 這就是無標籤資料。

cues.en: And there is a a place for unlabeled data as well.
cues.zh: 無標籤資料也有用途。

cues.en: We'll be talking more about that in the course when you would be using unlabeled data.
cues.zh: 課程會進一步討論什麼時候使用。

cues.en: For example, in a clustering type algorithm, you would be using unlabeled data.
cues.zh: 例如分群演算法，就使用無標籤資料。

cues.en: So you go, that's types of data.
cues.zh: 以上就是資料類型。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed, and I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 這裡快速整理剛才內容，期待下一堂見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
